appearance_facts.fact: Five circular blue data points are arranged in a diagonal line rising from the bottom-left to the top-right.
The lowest and leftmost point is labeled 'Region A', positioned near the x-axis value of 30 and y-axis value of 70.
The second point from the left is labeled 'Region B', positioned near the x-axis value of 40 and y-axis value of 115.
The middle point is labeled 'Region C', positioned near the x-axis value of 50 and y-axis value of 140.
The second point from the right is labeled 'Region D', positioned near the x-axis value of 60 and y-axis value of 160.
The highest and rightmost point is labeled 'Region E', positioned near the x-axis value of 70 and y-axis value of 175.

printed_facts.fact: Title reads 'Top Regions: Ad Spend vs Sales'.
Vertical axis is labeled 'Sales ($ thousands)' with tick marks ranging from 70 to 180 in increments of 10.
Horizontal axis is labeled 'Advertising Spend ($ thousands)' with tick marks ranging from 25 to 75 in increments of 5.
Each point has a text label directly above it identifying the region: Region A, Region B, Region C, Region D, Region E.
